annotations.title: Set the action at the threshold

description: What happens to an hourly server when the account balance reaches its threshold and no automatic reload brings it back: HIBERNATE (kept 12 h with an hourly hibernation fee, restarted as soon as the balance is back, then deleted) or DELETE (deleted at once, no hibernation fee, data lost). Machines that cannot be hibernated (spot) only accept DELETE. Spends nothing. (permission: servers:update) [Requires a free GPU Cloud account and MCP key]
name: gpucloud_set_server_threshold_action
title: Set the action at the threshold
